description: Compares 2 to 6 published products by name or ID and asks for clarification when a match is unclear. The compact answer includes daily amounts, rounded prices and applicable comparisons where available. Use detail "full" for the verified pack basis and detailed reference comparisons. The applicable comparison can vary with age and intake scope. Reference data only: it does not cover medication interactions, diagnosis or treatment decisions. Daily prices are rounded figures as published; they are not a basis for per-milligram or other derived costs.

country.description: The United States is the only market currently available.

detail.description: Compact answer by default. Use full for the complete published record.

period_days.description: Optional days of consumption, calculated from verified pack and daily-use basis. This is not a whole-pack checkout price.

products.description: Names of the products to compare.

items.description: Name on the label, with brand, strength and form where known.

name: compare_products
title: Compare products
